text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A race set to a backdrop of falling cherry blossoms—the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Vodka who went into races prepared for the chance that she might lose is gone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now determined to win every race, Vodka faces off against her biggest rival, Daiwa Scarlet, in the first race of the Classics.
